svg.title: The simulated atmosphere, 2033 to 2036
svg.desc: Day-by-day simulation. The air cools from 737 K to the CO₂ frost point, then warms to 288 K; surface pressure falls to 2.4 bar. Earth-like on 8 October 2036.
